title: LIVE: Six years on from COVID-19, is the world ready for the next pandemic?
content:

World leaders are meeting Friday to review the lessons learned and cement a new approach to prevention and preparation for the next pandemic. Hopes are high that a World Health Organization-led international agreement can move forward. Read Full Story on [...]

title: LIVE: World leaders approve new declaration to tackle rising sea levels
content:
Sea level rise is among the most visible consequences of global warming, but for some countries, it is an imminent existential threat. World leaders approved a new declaration on Thursday while debating the best ways to strengthen international cooperation and support vulnerable low-lying nations most at risk.
